item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 18/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a maritime airstream, the weather will be humid and foggy over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be rather warm during the day. A surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will fall over the region.

Wind: East force 2 to 3, becoming southeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny periods during the day. Misty with one or two light rain patches at night.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
